description: A distant parallax background layer ONLY for the Magical Forest in Dungeon Matcher, whimsical chunky native pixel art matching the supplied skeleton's disciplined rendering language, NOT its anatomy or colors. 256x160 landscape. Ancient cool blue-green forest depth, broad stepped evergreen and deciduous canopy masses, a calm vertical opening centered around x150 showing a small distant turquoise waterfall and low mossy stone bridge. Large simplified tree silhouettes recede along sides. Keep the lower half muted, dark and quiet for foreground enemy silhouettes; NO foreground ground or platform, no characters, no animals, no UI, no frames, no text, no lanterns, no runes, no flowers or mushrooms. Deep teal shadows, muted sage foliage and blue slate distant rocks, waterfall only a restrained cool accent. 3-4 broad discrete value groups for atmospheric depth, clean connected clusters and hard pixel edges, no dithering, no blurry haze, no outlines around every leaf, no tiny leaf noise, no pixel confetti, no painterly texture. Simplify as a native game environment rather than detailed illustration. The forest fills the entire opaque rectangular canvas. Top-left lighting. Repeated quiet shapes at outer edges to join side extensions.
